settings.name: Kai Rhodes
settings.headline: FRAME BY FRAME, STORY BY DESIGN.
settings.subtitle: Kai Rhodes — a cinematic video editor crafting films, commercials, and motion for brands who refuse to be forgettable.
settings.biography:
Twelve years cutting stories that hold attention hostage — from 30‑second ads to feature documentaries, always chasing the frame that makes people feel something before they know why.

I edit at the intersection of rhythm and restraint: pacing that respects the story, colour that respects the mood, sound design that never announces itself. My process is built in Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve, refined in After Effects, and finished with an obsessive attention to the first three seconds.

Based between Los Angeles and remote, working with agencies, filmmakers, and founders who need footage to feel like film.

projects.title: Solace — Launch Film
projects.description: A 90‑second brand film for a sleep-tech startup, cut to build calm through rhythm — long holds, patient sound design, a reveal that lands in silence.
projects.challenge: A sleep-tech brand needed a launch film that felt calm rather than 'techy' — without leaning on cliché slow-motion product shots.
projects.process: Structured the edit around breath — literal pacing tied to a resting heart rate, colour desaturated 15%, sound design built from field recordings, not stock.
projects.results: 3.1M organic views in the first month and the brand's highest-converting landing page asset to date.

projects.title: Aurora — "Static" Music Video
projects.description: Beat-synced editing across three timelines and 40+ hours of footage, compressed into a 3‑minute video engineered for repeat viewing.
projects.challenge: 40+ hours of multi-cam concert and narrative footage needed to cut down to a single 3‑minute story without losing the live energy.
projects.process: Built a beat-map first, cut picture to the map across three parallel timelines, then merged the strongest performance takes per section.
projects.results: Premiered on the label's YouTube channel, entered the platform's music trending page within 6 hours.

projects.title: Maren & Cole — Wedding Film
projects.description: A documentary-style cut built from twelve hours of coverage, structured around vows and unscripted moments rather than a shot list.
projects.challenge: Capturing the emotional essence of a wedding without falling back on stock transition formulas and standard cinematic templates.
projects.process: Built the entire cut around dialogue tracks rather than background music, creating an intimate soundstage, combined with warm natural grading.
projects.results: Delivered a lifelong heirloom with highly emotional client reception and 3 referral bookings.

projects.title: Nomad — Travel Ad
projects.description: High-octane commercial cut for premium adventure gear brand, optimized for CTR.
projects.challenge: High pace requirements within strict social guidelines.
projects.process: Dynamic kinetic typesetting matched with sound cues.

projects.title: Late Bloom — Short Film
projects.description: Slow-burn indie drama editing emphasizing long takes and negative space.
projects.challenge: Pacing dialogue-heavy scenes without letting the tension drop.
projects.process: Slight breathing delays added to reaction shots.
